sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Yes/no questions can use the same basic word order with question intonation. Question words such as ki, mi, *hol*, mit and miért introduce information questions.

ki, mi, hol, mit, miért — five short words that unlock most of the questions you’ll ever need to ask. Notice most of them are one syllable; Hungarian keeps its core question words compact, which is good news for your memory even as the sentences built around them get more complex.
